author: Rahul
content: Great tip. How do you feel windsor compares to autofac?

author: Ankit Vijay
content: Hi Rahul. Glad that you like it. Well, autofac is definitely more popular these days. it is considered modern container as compared to Castle Windsor. If I start a new project today, I might consider using Autofac over Castle Windsor. Having said that, Castle Windsor is actively maintained and updated in GitHub as well. So, you are not making a wrong choice choosing Castle Windsor as your IoC container 🙂
